replies.author: KomodoLord1
replies.body: Good idea and I think that you did well in keeping it simple but playable. I think there isn't enough aesthetics on the map to fill up the open spaces and also there is too much diamond instead of iron. The block palette is a bit bland and this map is kind of similar to lots of others however it does have good spacing. Overall, good concept but could use some more improvement when it comes to filling the cobblestone spaces.

replies.author: Skquid
replies.body:
It is a very interesting looking layout, I do have a few suggestions:
  • as suggested above, make the side islands a bit closer, and add more detail to the square islands
  • The spawn has a wooden theme, maybe add a few small buildings that continue that theme
  • The middle Island might need to be longer on the sides 
  • Try thinking about height overall. This does give the rendezvous vibe, but I suggest adding more depth and 3D structure by adding in elevated parts or depressed parts
  • A little bit too much stone, and maybe use something to help the stone flow into the wool, such as clay, as the transition between the two is a bit sudden
  • Maybe make the islands thicker, it feels too thin at that scale, and it could help with the overall gameplay in the defending aspect
  • The emerald monuments looks a bit too big. If you decide to make it smaller, maybe add a small overhang from the island as it would be a bit hard to reach.
  • Maybe add more height by a use of a tower in the mid that does not obstruct the island, but adds more detail
  • The spawn buildings need a bit more variation with the wood
  • Add an elevated edge to the sides of the island, like a trim 
Once again, these are just my suggestions, just to help improve the map aesthetics a little bit. Overall, I like the layout and island count, just some changes could help.

replies.author: Stuarts
replies.body:
Nice map ! As mentioned previously, the map could use a little more height in some areas and that the monuments are too far apart, judging by the looks of it. I like the retro feel of the map and how it reminds me of the rendez-vous series.

It sure will be interesting to see how this plays out !
